Scripts.OnAttributeChanged: if name == "index" then -- Update visual self:CallMethod("Update", value) -- Set spell name for cancelaura from secure context local unit = self:GetParent():GetAttribute("unit") or "player" local filter = self:GetParent():GetAttribute("filter") local buffName if filter == "HELPFUL" then buffName = UnitBuff(unit, value) else buffName = UnitDebuff(unit, value) end if buffName then self:SetAttribute("spell", buffName) end elseif name == "target-slot" then self:CallMethod("UpdateTempEnchant", value) end
